record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: PARAS and PARASECT declare ABSORB (passive NONE in the catalog). Strategy is shared; differences are stars and stats. Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target special damage (raw table 30 / 60 / 120 / 240 by stars). Independently of the damage call, every same-team entity in the 3x3 block around the CASTER (the caster's own cell included) is sent a heal REQUEST of 0.1 x the raw table amount - 3 for PARAS (1 star), 6 for PARASECT (2 stars) - with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag, so handleHeal scales it by the CASTER's AP and critPower. The request is not 10% of the damage dealt and does not read takenDamage: it is made identically when the damage call returns 0 (protected / skydiving / magic bounce), when a shield absorbs the hit and when the target dies. handleHeal is called in this order (core-mechanics.md section J2): the wound branch first - a wounded recipient gets no HP, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the same call requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), recipient, apBoost, crit) with the recipient as the shield's caster, which the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt) turns into the final shield; then the guard hp > 0 && !status.protect (an unwounded Protected recipient gets nothing; Rune Protect alone does not block); then the modifiers (AP, crit, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2), Math.round and the cap at missing HP; the post-modifier overheal on a Grass-synergy recipient requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP. 'No direct HP healing' therefore does not mean 'no shield or max-HP / current-HP effect'. Requested amount, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield are three different things. The enemy target and enemy neighbours are not recipients.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target); heal: allies adjacent to the caster, not to the target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: single target for damage; 3x3 block centered on the caster (clipped at board edges, center included) for the heal

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: Requested amount is the raw table value; applied damage is intermediate: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps. handleSpecialDamage returns 0 and deals nothing when the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce. The returned takenDamage is NOT read by this strategy; the heal requests below are independent of it and are made even when the damage call returns 0 (probe: damage call returns 0 or 999, requests are 3 either way). The shield, flinch, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band accounting of takenDamage (core-mechanics.md section J1) therefore does not feed any ABSORB effect.

effects.scaling: requested = 0.1 x the raw table amount (before AP and before the target's defenses); handleHeal multiplies by (1 + AP/100) with the CASTER's ap (apBoost 1) and by the caster's critPower when the cast crit, then x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather on the recipient/weather
effects.resolution: requested = 0.1 x the raw table amount, per recipient (3 / 6), before the caster's AP and crit factors; handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored values differ per recipient. handleHeal is called in this order (core-mechanics.md section J2): the wound branch first - a wounded recipient gets no HP, but with BLOODMOON weather and a Blood Stone owned by its player the same call requests addShield(round(0.3 x stones x the raw requested heal), recipient, apBoost, crit) with the recipient as the shield's caster, which the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt) turns into the final shield; then the guard hp > 0 && !status.protect (an unwounded Protected recipient gets nothing; Rune Protect alone does not block); then the modifiers (AP, crit, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2), Math.round and the cap at missing HP; the post-modifier overheal on a Grass-synergy recipient requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal), which also raises current HP. 'No direct HP healing' therefore does not mean 'no shield or max-HP / current-HP effect'. Requested amount, handleHeal's returned healReceived / overheal and the final stored hp / maxHP / shield are three different things. The 3x3 list includes the caster's own cell, so the caster is a recipient too; only entities whose team equals the caster's team are recipients (the damage target is not).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3 (120) and 4 (240, also the fallback) entries are declared in the table but unused by the two bound baseline classes (stars 1, 2). maxPP 110 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Heal depends on same-team occupants of the 3x3 block around the caster at cast time; the damage needs a target in range (requiresTarget true). Cells outside the board are skipped.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats damage and heal; nothing accumulates.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 30/60 (PARAS/PARASECT), heal request 3/6 (10 % of the raw table amount, not of damage dealt). Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1). Heal request = 0.1 x the raw table (3 / 6) per recipient, unaffected by the target's defense, shield, takenDamage or death. handleHeal returns healReceived = round(request x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower] x item/status/weather factors) capped at each recipient's missing HP (0 HP for a wounded recipient or an unwounded Protected one); the final stored changes also include a wounded recipient's Blood Moon / Blood Stone addShield request and a Grass recipient's addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) request, each through its item helpers.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, minimum of 1 and the protect / skydiving / magicBounce block were read here
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side and heal-side multipliers were read
unresolved: Whether the cell value type allows non-PokemonEntity occupants that would affect the team check (cell.value.team === pokemon.team was read as written)
Resurrection and other death-cancelling effects on the target do not affect the heal (takenDamage is unused) but may affect the damage; not enumerated

Whether any item or synergy effect changes ABSORB beyond what is listed; consulted: handleSpecialDamage, PokemonState.handleDamage (speDef step, minimum 1) and PokemonState.handleHeal (wound, AP, crit, burn, enraged, weather, overheal), the sibling BITE record for takenDamage accounting
PARAS and PARASECT have no passive in the catalog; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleHeal, addShield, addMaxHP) and the real AbsorbStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units, boards and call targets (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, sections SHARED_HELPERS and IMPORT_RECHECK_2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in board, stand-in damage target): PARAS heal requests 3 for the caster and an ally at 50/100 (HP 53) while the damage call returns 0, and the same when it returns 999; PARASECT requests 6; at AP 100 the request stays 3 and handleHeal doubles it (overheal 6 for a full-HP caster); a wounded ally under Blood Moon with a stone gets addShield(1); an unwounded Protected ally gets nothing; a full-HP Grass ally gets overheal 3 and a max-HP gain; a burning ally receives 2.
